notes.title: Regarding the game data update (ver2.10)
notes.content:
We have updated the game data.
[h3]Before updating your game data on Steam, please back up your game data to a different location, such as your desktop.[/h3]

[h2]Updates:[/h2]
・It previously took a long time for images to load upon starting up the game, especially when many images needed to be loaded at once, such as in battle or in the gallery. We have pinpointed the cause and fixed it, so images will now load much faster.

・When playing the English or Simplified Chinese versions, the keyword "Merchant" is sometimes not obtained even when the "Halfwit" option is selected in the "Lower Level Gatekeeper" conversation on the 7th floor of the "Monster-Human Dungeon."

To solve this problem, switch the language to "Japanese" or "Traditional Chinese" and select "Halfwit" (look for the characters "半端者" or "殘缺者") to obtain the "Merchant" keyword.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882764/00878578d8190d358812ae17d0f0b8a37b5168ef.jpg[/img]
